put.description: This endpoint serves an anonymous caller only when the waiting input node sets public: true. No credential at all is admitted on a public node; a private node answers 403. A credential that is present but invalid is still 401, including on a public node, and never degrades to an accepted anonymous delivery. Instance status reads are public while the instance waits on a public input node, and the single form and workflow-definition reads are public, so an anonymous caller fetches the payload contract itself.

parameters.name: branch_id

audience.description:
Audience is the value a token's aud claim must carry for this API. It
is the verifier's audience, so a frontend knows whether to request a
distinct resource audience or whether the client id already serves as
one.

email_verification_enabled.description:
EmailVerificationEnabled says whether a registered account stays
pending until its mailed link is consumed over POST
/v1/auth/verify-email.

local_enabled.description:
LocalEnabled reports the built-in local login: POST
/v1/auth/register and POST /v1/auth/login with HS256 JWTs verified
as Bearer [REDACTED]

registration_enabled.description:
RegistrationEnabled says whether POST /v1/auth/register admits
self-registration, or users arrive from an admin only.

roles.description:
Roles is every role name the role catalog knows, so a frontend
can label a role before the caller has one.

permissions.description:
Permission is the union of the caller's role permissions. The service
principal reports every known action.

roles.description:
Roles are the roles the live token asserted. An empty array means the
caller is authenticated but holds no role.

service.description: Service marks the API-token principal, which bypasses authorization.

debug.description:
Debug starts a step-through run: paused at create, re-paused after
every node until termination. Immutable after create.

snapshot_forms.description:
SnapshotForms freezes every referenced form's schema/ui into the
instance at creation. Status then serves the frozen bytes.

enabled.description: Enabled defaults to true when omitted.

schema.description:
Schema is the full node-object JSON Schema for Type, or null when
the type is unknown to this build. It describes the inline
workflow-occurrence shape; content is the same object minus the
graph routing fields, which a frontend ignores here.

builtin.description:
Builtin reports a core engine type. Registered custom types carry
false.

schema.description:
Schema is the full node-object JSON Schema for Type, or null when a
custom type registered no schema. Docs-only; Go parsers stay
authoritative.

accept.description:
Accept lists the request media types the node delivers. A frontend
reads it to decide between a JSON body and a multipart upload.

allowed_roles.description:
AllowedRoles is the node's role gate. Empty means the node is open to
any caller that holds input:deliver, unless AllowedUsers is
non-empty; the two gates are a union, so a listed role passes even
when AllowedUsers is non-empty. Always empty on a public node,
which ignores both gates.

allowed_users.description:
AllowedUsers is the node's user gate: a listed user may deliver
regardless of their roles. The two gates are a union, so a listed
role passes even when this list is non-empty. Empty means no user
restriction, and like AllowedRoles it is always empty on a public
node.

form.description:
Form carries the frozen bytes when the instance was created with
snapshot_forms. Absent for live instances and formless nodes.

public.description:
Public reports that the node accepts anonymous deliveries over HTTP
with no credential, even when auth is on. While the instance parks
here, anonymous callers also read this contract from the public
status projection and the form from the public form read.

record_actor.description:
RecordActor reports that an accepted delivery is written as the
attribution envelope {user_id, input_data} rather than the bare
payload, so the frontend knows which shape the context will hold.

email_verified.description:
EmailVerified is false while a self-registered account awaits its
verification link.

is_active.description: IsActive is false for a disabled (soft-deleted) account.

is_local.description: IsLocal reports a password account rather than an OIDC identity.

roles.description:
Roles are a local user's stored roles. OIDC callers carry theirs
on the live token, so this is empty for them.

schemas.description:
Schemas holds the node-object JSON Schema of every node type this
definition actually uses, keyed by type. It is computed on read from
the current code, so it describes the current engine, not the code
the definition was authored against.

ApiKeyAuth.description: API token authentication via the X-Api-Token header. The token authenticates as the service principal, which bypasses every authorization gate. Failed presentations are throttled per client IP (auth.rate_limit): past the configured threshold further attempts answer 429 with a Retry-After until the block expires.
ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Token

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token: an OIDC JWT or a locally issued one. In the Swagger Authorize dialog type "Bearer <jwt>" with the Bearer prefix and a space: the value is sent verbatim as the Authorization header. For OIDC the engine is a resource server: the frontend completes a code+PKCE flow against the provider and calls the API with the JWT. For local auth the frontend logs in over POST /v1/auth/login. Which logins exist is served by GET /v1/auth/config.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
